doc.title: Javon Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 3, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Non-musical pastimes: documentaries and reading
summary: He watches documentaries such as Chisholm '72 and plans to read novels again.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Have you taken up any non-musical activities that you would never have pictured doing?

Never pictured doing. I’ve never been a major TV watcher but I found myself watching some series or doing more watching of documentaries on TV, those have been good for me. I just watched Chisholm ’72 about Shirley Chisholm and her run for the presidency. Obviously I was a young guy then so that was great. And so now I need to again get some books back out, some novels, and read, which is something I used to do a lot but sometimes you get busy and you get away from that. So in that way it’s been kind of an opportunity to reset a little bit.
